---
title: "Publications"
---
[Generated automatically from [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Kerollos+Wanis%5BAuthor%5D&sort=date).]{.text-muted style="font-size: 0.85em;"}

```{=html}
<div id="pubmed-pubs">Loading publications...</div>

<script>
async function fetchPubMed() {
  const query = 'Kerollos Wanis[Author]';
  const searchUrl = `https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=pubmed&term=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&retmax=200&sort=date&retmode=json`;

  try {
    const searchRes = await fetch(searchUrl);
    const searchData = await searchRes.json();
    const ids = searchData.esearchresult.idlist;

    if (!ids.length) {
      document.getElementById('pubmed-pubs').innerHTML = 'No publications found.';
      return;
    }

    const summaryUrl = `https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=pubmed&id=${ids.join(',')}&retmode=json`;
    const summaryRes = await fetch(summaryUrl);
    const summaryData = await summaryRes.json();

    const byYear = {};

    for (const id of ids) {
      const article = summaryData.result[id];
      const title = article.title;
      const journal = article.fulljournalname || article.source;
      const pubdate = article.pubdate || '';
      const year = pubdate.substring(0, 4) || 'Forthcoming';
      const authors = article.authors
        ? article.authors.map(a => a.name).join(', ')
        : '';
      const doi = (article.elocationid || '').replace('doi: ', '');
      const pmidLink = `https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/${id}/`;

      if (!byYear[year]) byYear[year] = [];
      byYear[year].push({ authors, title, journal, pubdate, doi, pmidLink });
    }

    const years = Object.keys(byYear).sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));
    let html = '';

    for (const year of years) {
      html += `<h3>${year}</h3>`;
      for (const p of byYear[year]) {
        html += `<p style="margin-bottom: 1em;">`;
        html += p.authors.replace(/(Wanis KN)/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
        html += `. ${p.title} <em>${p.journal}</em>. ${p.pubdate}.`;
        if (p.doi) html += ` <a href="https://doi.org/${p.doi}">[DOI]</a>`;
        html += ` <a href="${p.pmidLink}">[PubMed]</a>`;
        html += `</p>`;
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('pubmed-pubs').innerHTML = html;
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('pubmed-pubs').innerHTML = 'Failed to load publications. <a href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Wanis+KN%5BAuthor%5D&sort=date">View on PubMed</a>';
  }
}

fetchPubMed();
</script>
```
